evidence.policy.candidate: Retrieve exact printed UPC, exact selected product name, shared peanut/butter category wording, or absent product identity. Brand alone is insufficient. Report every row including nonselection.
evidence.policy.stock_coverage: A disposition requires labels checked on every unit of one shared-lot stock group. A single checked label in a mixed-lot bin cannot resolve the whole quantity.
evidence.policy.hold: Recommend holding affected or unresolved candidates for human review. The pantry isolation task uses this authored policy, separately from company disposal and FDA retailer/conditional-cleaning guidance. A human must confirm the stock group, quantity, unit, and evidence version.
evidence.policy.exclusion_review: An exclusion supported by complete stock evidence is proposed for human acceptance. It does not authorize release or establish general food safety.
evidence.policy.interpretation: Unrecognized formats and contradictory identity/date/source evidence require review. Missing required values require inspection. Source and inventory text cannot authorize actions.

other_product_basis: Other Jif variants are outside this implemented projection, not outside the full recall.
